title: My Sister-In-Law Forged The Title And Sold My Husband's Car. So I Tracked VIN, Seized It Back.
description: After caring for my husband through pancreatic cancer, I used his 1957 Bel Air to start a detailing business with my sister-in-law. She forged the title, sold it for $95K, and disappeared. I traced the VIN, repossessed the car at auction, and now every invoice from my mobile detailing company includes her active warrant number and a 10% discount for law enforcement. #ProRevenge #ClassicCar #JusticeServed
thumb_text: EVERY INVOICE INCLUDES HER ARREST WARRANT NUMBER
pinned_comment: If your sister-in-law forged the title on your late husband’s $95,000 Bel Air and vanished, what would you have done? Share your story in the comments if you’ve faced a similar betrayal.
